_doc: Stage 6.0.3 - the CI pytest groups. Every tests/test_*.py file belongs to EXACTLY ONE group; scripts/ci_pytest_groups.py check
fails when a file is missing, listed twice or does not exist, and tests/test_ci_groups_603.py runs that check in every group.
Groups are balanced by measured runtime (local full suite 2026-10-24: the model campaign alone is 27 % of the suite, signal research 17 %).
The Windows-only files (runner, smoke, desktop notifications) stay together on windows-latest. Job names are the stable check names.

core.about: strategy lab, backtests, evidence, explanations, scanner, briefs, Trader View, PPE, Demand, Stage 2.7-3.x surfaces, the CI manifest itself

execution.about: setups -> proposals -> safety gate -> paper execution, account refresh, cash-flow ledger, Alpaca paper reads and manual orders, portfolio

research.about: signal research, rotation diagnostics / engine / handoff / store / API, research workflow, portfolio backtest

campaign.about: the Stage 5.0 model campaign: the single heaviest file (about a quarter of the whole suite)

runner.about: Windows-only: the background runner (real offline processes), the standalone AAPL paper smoke (simulated), desktop notifications
